campaign:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: original printed retail artwork atlas for the playable Star Agent space-station shops. Produce ONE square image divided precisely into four equal square quadrants with no gutters, no borders and no lettering anywhere. Each quadrant is an independent editorial product illustration, intended for cropping onto a physical poster; not a render of a shop or a mockup of paper.
Top-left quadrant: close portrait of a purposeful manufactured orbital security helmet with a dark visor, ivory armour shell, dark petrol polymer and a small pale mint status lamp, dramatic restrained industrial advertising photography against deep petrol. No person visible inside. Main helmet fits fully within its quadrant.
Top-right quadrant: a fictional compact security sidearm with a closed hard-shell case and a pair of practical work gloves, laid out as a carefully maintained duty kit, ivory metal and dark petrol polymer on softly textured warm ivory paper. No hands, bullets, firing or violence. Original design.
Bottom-left quadrant: a beautifully detailed compact spacecraft drive module, cylindrical impeller and machined cooling rings, ivory ceramic and brushed steel, ochre service tabs, against matte warm charcoal; three-quarter product illustration. Original believable aerospace hardware, not a large spaceship.
Bottom-right quadrant: an exploded product illustration of an orbital life-support filter canister, pleated filter cartridge and machined end caps arranged clearly along one diagonal, ivory metal, brushed steel and muted ochre, on warm paper with faint engineering drafting lines but NO text.
Style: sophisticated lived-in industrial spaceflight commercial photography and lithographic print, coherent art direction, exquisite physical material detail and slight paper grain, no glossy videogame neon. Colour family only deep petrol, ivory, charcoal, brushed steel, muted ochre and restrained pale mint. Even quad grid, no frame, no extra panels, no text, logos, watermark, labels or human figures. All subjects inset inside their own quadrant by at least 8% so poster crops preserve silhouettes.
carpet:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: square seamless diffuse base-colour texture of a worn commercial spaceship shop carpet, viewed orthographically directly from above, filling the entire image edge to edge. This is a production surface texture for a game, not a photograph of a carpet in a room.
Primary request: realistic tightly woven charcoal-grey low-pile contract carpet with very fine irregular heathered wool fibres, slightly matted paths and old ground-in dust, a few subtle brownish maintenance stains and tiny pale fibres. Restrained worn appearance of a busy industrial trade counter; a credible cared-for but old floor, not abandoned or filthy.
Composition: flat uniform scale over approximately a 1.5 metre square patch; non-directional subtle wear, no rug border, no objects, no floor tiles, no text. Seamless opposite edges, no obvious large repeating motifs.
Lighting: completely flat diffuse albedo, no perspective, no directional light, no cast shadows, no highlights, no ambient occlusion gradient or vignette. Neutral medium-dark charcoal, small warm grey fibre variation, texture detail stays fine and subtle. No normals or depth represented by coloured lighting.
